title: The Question Comes First

palette.why: A bright lilac studio with warm paper and citron planning tabs puts curious student work in daylight. Deep violet shelves give the archive equal visual authority. It diverges from September11 spruce/cream/berry and September10 charcoal/cyan/magenta; no landscape palette or default blue.

light.direction: Upper left key, diagonal shadows toward lower right
light.key: Warm ivory key on paper and skin, firm enough to show folds and layered stock
light.fill: Cool violet fill one value step below each base
light.rim: Narrow pale citron rim on the headset crown and exposed page edges
light.depth: Three true Stage3D planes at z=480,160,0; contact shadows anchor every notebook/headset; background fixtures sit behind subject planes, never texture pasted on top.

shape_language.grammar: Rounded headset ribs and supple paper curves contrast with precise archive slots and rectangular test spaces.
shape_language.why: The instrument supplies structured measurements while a foldable notebook holds open research choices. Dotted outlines belong only to planned task/output areas; solid pages show available public data.

casting.hero: Sheet composed as one stitched research notebook
casting.new_asset: EEGHeadset, a neutral reusable research sensor with exactly19 scalp contacts in its explanatory array, two distinct earclips and three empty auxiliary sockets
casting.why: Paper, human rig, hand, trace and token are already on the shelf. No existing sensor is worn on a scalp, so the EEG silhouette is the one real subject gap. Generic illustrated students carry no named likeness claim.

hero_moves: Notebook springs open and stops against its concealed NEXT STEP wing
Nineteen contacts expand into a counted schematic then settle into one recording device
Public page slides through selection and comparison work areas while the new device rests
A hand assesses a new task and unfolds an extra collection-and-test workspace
A distinct hypothetical participant enters TEST without ever entering TRAINING
motion_language.timing: Anticipation, overshoot and settle for page hinges and hand gestures; light cable follow-through on the headset, book-page recoil and breathing/blinking on human rigs. One snap-in on the revealed NEXT STEP, no frantic continuous zoom.
motion_language.blur: 180-degree motion smear only during page wipes and a quick paper shuffle. Hold the identity tab crisp above the wipe.

composition.safe_area: Story essentials within x90..990 and y490..1270; captions stay y1336..1468. Square crop y420..1500 retains every claim and action. Portrait-only brand above420 is nonessential.
sets: Lab bench with window and instrument stand
Public-data archive shelves and comparison desk
Programming desktop with separate planned eye-movement marker
composition.hierarchy: One central action in each shot, then a large short annotation, then provenance/plan label. At least four scales and three camera heights. No side-by-side tiny dashboard.
composition.signature_shot: The same small stitched notebook expands sideways into a broad two-route workbench: a public-data page still actively in use and a new TO COLLECT / TO TEST wing, with no answer manufactured.
composition.paper_identity: A coral NEXT STEP tab, stitched spine and dog-ear persist in every view. The new wing remains concealed until the late payoff; earlier pages change pose without revealing it.

negative_space_beats.staging: Archive fixtures recede behind the isolated schematic scalp trace and an empty interpretation area on ivory. Keep the SCHEMATIC label and notebook identity tab. The trace stops before the empty field.
negative_space_beats.purpose: Give measurement and interpretation visibly different spaces.

negative_space_beats.staging: Clear loose stationery and secondary fixtures out of the central square-safe field while the same notebook wing opens. Keep the active public page at left and the new TO COLLECT / TO TEST spaces empty at right.
negative_space_beats.purpose: Make added workspace the reveal while both research routes remain readable.

craft_advance.change: Honor arbitrary text instead of silently rendering WHO EARNED THIS, with measured two-line fit and explicit colors while preserving legacy defaults.
craft_advance.proof: Use NEXT STEP and TEST? tokens in this film and render long and short copy at phone size; preserve legacy default in a comparison still.
craft_advance.why: The shelf advertises custom copy but the current component ignores it. A real generic question prop keeps story language in the asset parameter rather than one-off substitutes.

binding_corrections: Planned reading and programming remain labeled in every shot
Waiting participant carries GENERAL METHODS EXAMPLE / IF NEW PEOPLE from its plant
The public route performs selection and analysis without a fabricated result
One complete rough cut precedes polished hero work
treatment_deviation: The scoring room's suggested ink-blue/green/copper palette is replaced deliberately with lilac/ivory/citron/coral because it is more distinct from the two recent films; the material notebook and warm celebratory intent are preserved.
